basic_info.description: Welcome to 2695 Newhall, a beautiful, well maintained, 3 bed, 2.5 bath home built in 1997, located in San Francisco's sunny Portola Place, boasting an abundance of natural light throughout. Upon entering you are greeted by a spacious living room, a cozy fireplace, formal dining room & convenience of a full bathroom for guests. As you make your way to the back, the breakfast area opens to a private balcony, celebrating California's quintessential year-round indoor/outdoor lifestyle, & your backyard oasis offering mature fruit tree & a blank canvas for gardening enthusiasts. The intuitive & thoughtful floor plan places all bedrooms upstairs. Retreat to the primary bedroom, which includes a luxurious walk-in closet & a private en-suite bathroom. Two additional well-appointed bedrooms ensure ample space for relaxation & personalization. An additional full bathroom, serves the remaining bedrooms. The lower level features a spacious 2 car garage, laundry area & bonus space with lots of potential. Conveniently surrounded by every day conveniences, 2695 Newhall is a commuter's dream in a prime location with easy fwy access, & close proximity to 101 Freeway, MUNI, Caltrain & Bart. This rare tri-level home is a wonderful opportunity you do not want to miss! Welcome to 2695Newhall.com
